description: Produce a standard-library Python module that computes a quality report for an array of records, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need a computed quality summary of a record array: counts, presence, nulls, completeness ratio, exact duplicates. Do not choose this for statistical or semantic quality (outliers, drift, schema conformance beyond the fixed checks). Example requests: Write a Python module that reports record count, per-field presence and duplicate count for a dataset, with tests. | I need a data-quality summary: null counts, completeness ratio, exact duplicates. | Generate a dataset-quality report module and test it.
